title: My alarm went off while I was away from home
body:
We are sorry that this happened! We strongly recommend saving your Home Location in the Lasso App’s Settings > Set Up.

Then, if your alarm rings while you are away from home, you can tap the ‘Emergency’ button at the top of the in-app alarm screen to stop the alarm.

We also recommend using the ‘Next Alarm’ lock screen widget to keep track of your scheduled alarms.
